verdict.rationale: The evidence documents no bulk-operation capability, such as bulk-editing, toggling or deleting many flags, segments or identities in one action. The Admin API, CLI and MCP server are per-resource programmatic building blocks a user could script loops over. Segment-wide overrides are a targeting feature (one flag applied to many users), not bulk operations across many items, so neither earns credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
